name: bracket-ladder-run-placement-no-total
description: The case `placement` exists for: the board says WHERE the run sits but never states how many ('* 200m run in between sets' - no '(5 total)'). occurrences is absent; placement 'between_sets' alone makes the count derivable, because six sets hold exactly five gaps. This is what a free-text cadence note could never do - it would have left the count to the tier-count fallback and printed 1200m. Breakdown totalDistance is 1000m, derived at save time by statedOccurrenceCount, and the poster prints the total because it is arithmetic on stated structure, not a guess.
